name: Mönchengladbach
registryBasis: The official City of Mönchengladbach Fachbereich Geoinformation / Fachbereich 62 identifies the local Liegenschaftskataster custodian and links the public Geoportal / Maps@MG cadastral viewer. The official geoportal ArcGIS Portal catalog exposes the ALKIS Flurstücke feature service for all parcels in the city.

queries.query: Mönchengladbach Germany official cadastral parcel map GIS ALKIS Flurstücke ArcGIS
queries.result: Search found the official City of Mönchengladbach Liegenschaftskataster page, the official city Geoportal, and the public cadastral viewer link. The current viewer/service was then followed directly and its official ArcGIS Portal catalog exposed the ALKIS parcel FeatureServer.

queries.query: Mönchengladbach Liegenschaftskataster Flurstücke Geoportal ALKIS offizielle Stadt
queries.result: Official German-language results identify the city's Fachbereich 62 / Abteilung Liegenschaftskataster, state that the Geoportal provides free non-official cadastral-map viewing, and document publicly accessible parcel information. The official catalog describes ALKIS Flurstücke covering the entire city and names FSK and ALKIS_ID among the object attributes.

officialLeads.operator: City of Mönchengladbach, Fachbereich Geoinformation 62 / Abteilung Liegenschaftskataster
officialLeads.scope: Local municipal cadastral custodian and public Geoportal entry point
officialLeads.observation: Official page states that the Geoportal provides online cadastral viewing and a free non-official parcel-map overview; it also documents the official cadastral-map request route and ALKIS data products without owner information.

officialLeads.scope: Official citywide ALKIS parcel FeatureServer catalog item
officialLeads.observation: Catalog item describes Liegenschaftskataster_Flurstuecke_Flaechen from ALKIS, all parcels in the entire city, weekly updates, cadastral accuracy, Fachbereich 62 responsibility, and the safe object attributes FSK and ALKIS_ID.
Viewer HTML loaded anonymously and revealed the current map.apps boot/configuration route; no login or credentials were used.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: HTTP 200; official page loaded and linked the cadastral viewer and local custodian information.
HTTP 200; current public map.apps viewer HTML loaded and exposed the boot script/configuration route.
HTTP 200; official ArcGIS Portal search returned the ALKIS Flurstücke item and related WFS/WMS/FeatureServer catalog records. The catalog item states citywide parcel coverage.
HTTP 200; service metadata loaded. Layer 16 is polygon geometry; native service CRS is EPSG:25832; citywide full extent and service description were available.

HTTP 200; layer schema loaded. Native fields include OBJECTID, FSK (Flurstückskennzeichen), Gemarkung, GMK, FLN, FSN, Amtliche_Flaeche, ALKIS_ID, Lagebezeichnung, and SHAPE. Only FSK/ALKIS_ID were selected for the bounded query; unsafe descriptive fields were not requested.

HTTP 200; bounded anonymous exact-point query at the supplied WUP point returned one polygon. Response native identity was ALKIS_ID DENW24AL60000S6f; geometry was returned in EPSG:4326 after requesting outSR=4326.

One initial bounded query requesting FSK and ALKIS_ID returned HTTP 400 Unable to complete operation; no geometry or data were used from that failed response. A retry with outFields=* succeeded; the retained sample still contains only the canonical ALKIS_ID and geometry.
